name: accordion
description: Progressive disclosure, as `<details>`. Native, so it works before the JavaScript arrives and its open state survives a print — a div-and-a-boolean gets neither.

summary.$description: `list-style:none` plus the WebKit pseudo removes the default triangle in every engine; the chevron replaces it so the marker matches the icon set rather than the platform.

reducedMotion.$description: The chevron still turns — it is the state, not decoration — it just turns instantly.

a11y.note: `<summary>` is a button to the accessibility tree already, with `aria-expanded` maintained by the browser. Do not add `role=button` or a manual `aria-expanded`: both fight what is already correct. The chevron is `aria-hidden` geometry; the open state is announced from the element.
